messages.text: Sorry to hear that. Is it that your DC06 hasn't arrived yet, or it's arrived and isn't working properly? Send your order number too if you have it, and I'll pull the order up.
I'm not sure how to pull up my order history anymore with the new site

You don't need to log in, I can find it for you here. What's the email you placed the order with? If you used a different one or can't remember, your full phone number or your name with your postcode ···· as well.

Thanks. I need the order number to open it from my side. It's on your order confirmation email from HeliumDeploy and starts with "Shop", something like Shop····. Searching your inbox for "HeliumDeploy" should bring it up. Can you send it over?

Found it. Your DC06 shipped with your NerdOctaxe and was delivered on July 15, so you've had it a couple of months.

What's it doing? Tell me what you're seeing, like not powering on, no hashrate, or dropping offline, and I'll help you narrow it down.
No hashrate, screen stuck on reboot and its flashing a quick power board error message
Handed to the team · Power board error is a hardware fault I can't diagnose from the product facts.

A power board error with a reboot loop usually points to the power supply, not the miner itself. Reseat the power cable at both ends, plug straight into the wall with no power strip, and try a different compatible PSU if you have one.

I've also passed this to our hardware tech, who'll jump into this chat. If you step away, the answer comes by email.

One thing he'll need to know: has the DC06 ever been overclocked or run on custom firmware?
No didn't allow me to do so and the firmware updates went from Hammer to Thorn OS guess that's what they are using now.

Good, then you're covered. The firmware moving over through the official updates doesn't count as modifying it.

If it's the PSU, we can replace just the PSU and you keep the miner. If the unit turns out faulty, the fix is a return through our RMA form, and you'll get a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Hold off on filling it in until our tech tells you which one it is. Did reseating the cable or trying a different outlet change anything?
